item.title: What You Need to Know About Snow Emergency Starting Sunday at 8 AM
item.description: A snow emergency for the city has been declared starting Sunday at 8 am, with a parking ban taking effect at that time. The city is encouraging residents to stay home and avoid travel, and if needed, please use public transportation. Once the snow emergency goes into effect, vehicles parked on major roads and main arteries will be towed. item.title: Hey Kid! Snow Shovel Fire Hydrant, Senior’s Sidewalk and Win JP Licks Gift Card
item.description: Hey parents, tell your kid that if they want a $15 gift certificate to JP Licks, all they’ve got to do is shovel out a fire hydrant, a senior citizen’s sidewalk, or someone else who needs help. The #SOSChallenge is sponsored by District 6 City Councilor Ben Weber, and state Rep. Bill MacGregor, and state Rep. Sam Montaño. Parents then need to take a photo of the shoveled out fire hydrant and tag @votebillmacgregor and @ben4district6… The post Hey Kid! Snow Shovel Fire Hydrant, Senior’s Sidewalk

item.title: JP Neighborhood Council Seeking Candidates After Delaying Election Twice Due to Lack of Candidates
item.description: After delaying elections twice, the Jamaica Plain Neighborhood Council is seeking more candidates for the upcoming springtime scheduled election. JPNC’s website states that its election was rescheduled for September “due to a lower number of candidate enrollments” and then due to another lack of new candidates, the election was postponed to this spring. item.title: Allandale’s Beloved Steer Curtis Passed Away
item.description: Sadly, after 18 years of living at Allandale Farm, Curtis the highland steer passed away on January 27. He and his brother Willard, who passed away last year, were beloved by children and adults, often attracting passersby to quickly pull into the lot after seeing the long-horned black shaggy bovines. item.title: Upgraded: First Church of JP Got a New Roof, Solar Panels, Rebuilding Clock and Bell Tower
item.description: The First Church of Jamaica Plain has had a very successful capital campaign during the last several months to raise money for a new roof, install solar panels, and rebuild its clock and bell tower.
